paragraphs: Ensure that each point in the agenda is covered by the listed person.
Ask the team to move a discussion to a relevant issue when appropriate.
The notetaker should take notes during the meeting and if action is required, creates a comment and assigns it to the appropriate person.
translations: 确保议程的每一项都由列出的负责人说明。
适当时，请团队把讨论移到相关工单。
记录员应在会上做记录，需要采取行动时留下评论，并将事项指派给合适的人。
fullTextParagraphs: The main role of the chair is to start the meeting, keep the meeting moving along, and end the meeting when appropriate. There is generally little preparation required, but depending on the meeting, the chair will include choosing a “feature of the week” or similar. Please check the agenda template for parts marked as “filled in by chair.”
During the meeting, the chair will:
Ensure that each point in the agenda is covered by the listed person.
Ask the team to move a discussion to a relevant issue when appropriate.
Copy the agenda template for the following week and tag the next chair/secretary.
If the chair is not available and has not picked a substitute, follow the rotation to the first person who is on the call to determine a replacement.
The notetaker should take notes during the meeting and if action is required, creates a comment and assigns it to the appropriate person.
If the notetaker is not available and has not picked a substitute, follow the rotation to the first person who is on the call to determine a replacement.
During the AMER team call, notetaking follows GitLab Meeting Best Practices on Live Doc Meetings. Anyone not speaking is encouraged to help take notes.
Emergencies and CMOC events handled (APAC only)

We include two sections on emergencies and CMOC events handled the prior week. We did this to highlight the work which on-call support engineers do as there were concerns team members were not necessarily aware of on-call work that had been done, especially on the weekends.

firstAttempt.prompt: 会上决定把帮助中心首页的三篇旧文章更新。Mia 周五前出稿，你周一复审。写一条会议纪要。
firstAttempt.sample: We agreed to update the three outdated articles on the help center homepage. Mia will draft the updates by Friday. I’ll review the drafts on Monday and flag anything that still needs work.
firstAttempt.rationale: 用 We agreed to 记录会议作出的决定。 用人名加 will 写清负责人。 用 flag 表示标出还需要处理的问题。
